about: Fixtures for an MDF 4 reader: logs written by the Eerie Leap firmware's own logger (Mdf4LoggerSensorReading), with asammdf's values. See README.md. Times are seconds (float64) as stored in the master channel; NaN would be null (none occurs).

generator.program: sources/main.cpp (a ztest app on native_sim, linked with rt_core read-only)
generator.rt_core_subject: tests: the publisher test's two-tick bound is computed in int64_t (2026-10-29)

can.description: Fixture 2 (raw CAN frames) and its unclosed and cut copies (fixture 3, CAN).
can.origin_note: unit-clock microseconds of the first file's header start (RtcProvider's fixed date plus uptime); every *_rel_us is microseconds after it

can_mixed.description: Extra: values and raw CAN sensors in one file.
can_mixed.origin_note: unit-clock microseconds of the first file's header start (RtcProvider's fixed date plus uptime); every *_rel_us is microseconds after it

conversions.description: Extra: conversions, comments and absent channels.
conversions.origin_note: unit-clock microseconds of the first file's header start (RtcProvider's fixed date plus uptime); every *_rel_us is microseconds after it

sensors.name: Functions
sensors.description: abs log sin cos tan sqrt
sensors.expression: abs(x) - log(x) + sin(x) * cos(x) + tan(x) / 10 + sqrt(x)
sensors.mdf_formula: abs(X) - log(X) + sin(X) * cos(X) + tan(X) / 10 + sqrt(X)

sensors.name: Raw not logged
sensors.description: has an expression, raw value off

empty.description: Extra: a closed log with no record.
empty.origin_note: unit-clock microseconds of the first file's header start (RtcProvider's fixed date plus uptime); every *_rel_us is microseconds after it

rotation.description: Fixture 4: one session of four sensors (an analog input with a raw value, an indicator, a virtual sensor with Only new data and a raw CAN sensor on bus 1) in two files made by rotation.
rotation.origin_note: unit-clock microseconds of the first file's header start (RtcProvider's fixed date plus uptime); every *_rel_us is microseconds after it

values.description: Fixture 1 (three sensors) and its unclosed and cut copies (fixture 3, values).
values.origin_note: unit-clock microseconds of the first file's header start (RtcProvider's fixed date plus uptime); every *_rel_us is microseconds after it

wide_ids.description: Extra: a record ID of two bytes.
wide_ids.origin_note: unit-clock microseconds of the first file's header start (RtcProvider's fixed date plus uptime); every *_rel_us is microseconds after it

files.name: can.mf4
files.description: One raw CAN frame sensor (bus 0, BusChannel 1): standard, extended, CAN FD, FD without BRS, transmitted frames, a 64 byte payload, a 10 byte FD payload (DLC 9), a shared timestamp, 30 ticks of 100 ms.
files.record_spans_note: [begin, end, sensor index in the family's sensors, CAN payload length] of every record call whose bytes lie wholly inside this file
